 "correlated_events":[{"text":"After-hours login activity was present on the case date and on both adjacent days, indicating repeated late-night access across 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-12.","evidence_ids":["L-c1875e","L-4df1ef","L-60f76f"]},{"text":"The repository sales-sandbox-1 appears outside the user’s expected repositories and outside listed entitlements.","evidence_ids":["L-994a13","IDN","PERM"]}],"conflicting_evidence":[{"text":"No change ticket, access request, or justification note was found in the returned logs for the allowed window, so there is no verified approval supporting the after-hours activity or the sales-sandbox-1 repository access.","evidence_ids":["L-4df1ef","L-994a13"]}],"missing_evidence":["No change_ticket event found in the allowed window for the case date or adjacent days.","No access_request event found in the allowed window for the case date or adjacent days.","No justification_note event found in the allowed window for the case date or adjacent days.","No verified approval reference was available to validate with check_approval.","No repo access event was returned on 2026-08-11 itself; only a prior new-repository access event on 2026-08-06 was available."],"evidence_ids":["L-c1875e","L-31cdd0","L-4df1ef","L-1e4fb8","L-60f76f","L-994a13","D1","E4","E5","IDN","PERM"],"confidence":"medium","recommended_follow_up":["Request human review to assess whether the unentitled/ unexpected repository access to sales-sandbox-1 has supporting records outside the returned log set.","Request human review to determine whether additional repository activity telemetry exists for 2026-08-11, since the question asks for repos accessed but no same-day repo event was returned.","If a ticket, access request, or travel/other approval reference becomes available, verify it with check_approval before treating it as justification."]}
